era.text: The contemporary United States of the late 2000s.

setting.text: Albuquerque, New Mexico, and the desert outside the city.

world_rules.text: The Drug Enforcement Administration actively investigates the local drug trade.
The world is realistic: there are no supernatural or science fiction elements.

locations.name: A1A Car Wash
locations.description: The car wash where Walter White works a second job.

locations.name: J. P. Wynne High School
locations.description: The school where Walter White teaches chemistry.

locations.name: Desert cook site
locations.description: A remote stretch of desert where a recreational vehicle serves as a lab.

characters.name: Walter White
characters.role: High school chemistry teacher who has secretly begun producing methamphetamine.

goals.text: Keep his new work hidden from his family and from Hank.

known_facts.text: He teaches chemistry and works a second job at a car wash.
He co-founded Gray Matter Technologies before becoming a teacher.

characters.status: Alive; recently diagnosed with lung cancer.

relationships.description: Walter cooks methamphetamine with his former student Jesse.
Hank is Walter's brother-in-law and does not suspect him.
The player audits the books of the car wash where Walter works.

characters.name: Jesse Pinkman
characters.role: Walter's former student, now his partner in the drug trade.

known_facts.text: He is a small-time methamphetamine cook and dealer.

relationships.description: Walter cooks methamphetamine with his former student Jesse.

characters.name: Hank Schrader

goals.text: Find out who is behind the new methamphetamine in Albuquerque.

known_facts.text: He is an agent of the Drug Enforcement Administration.

characters.status: Alive; investigating the local drug trade.

relationships.description: Hank is Walter's brother-in-law and does not suspect him.

characters.name: Marisol Vega
characters.role: Shift manager at the car wash who keeps the daily cash log.

known_facts.text: She has noticed that the register totals stopped matching the log.

factions.name: Drug Enforcement Administration
factions.description: The federal agency investigating the Albuquerque drug trade.

relationships.description: Walter cooks methamphetamine with his former student Jesse.
Hank is Walter's brother-in-law and does not suspect him.
The player audits the books of the car wash where Walter works.

important_conflicts.name: Walter's double life
important_conflicts.description: Walter hides a criminal enterprise from a family that includes a DEA agent.
important_conflicts.stakes: Exposure would destroy his family and his freedom.

player_role.title: Forensic accountant
player_role.description: A freelance accountant hired to tidy the car wash's books before a sale.
player_role.reason_for_presence: The owner wants clean accounts, so the player spends days on site.

connections.description: Walter works the register and is the last person to handle the cash.

starting_location.rationale: A small, enclosed workplace where the player naturally meets Walter.

opening_conflict.title: Cash That Does Not Add Up
opening_conflict.summary: The register is short again and Walter was the last one on shift. Hank drops by to see his brother-in-law just as the player finds the gap.
opening_conflict.immediate_goal: Decide what to do with the discrepancy before Hank leaves.
decision_options: Mention it in front of Hank
opening_conflict.stakes: The player can earn Walter's trust or draw the attention of a DEA agent.

timeline_context.canon_cutoff: Season 1, shortly after Walter and Jesse become partners
timeline_context.summary: Walter White has been diagnosed with cancer and has just pressured Jesse Pinkman into cooking methamphetamine with him.
